name: Zoltán Kovács
bio:
Zoltán Kovács's journey in motorsport began not on the track, but in the garage. From a young age, he was fascinated by the intricate workings of engines, spending countless hours disassembling and reassembling anything he could get his hands on. This practical foundation led him to pursue a degree in mechanical engineering, after which he immediately sought out opportunities in racing.

Before joining Prema Junior, Zoltán honed his skills at smaller teams, steadily climbing the ranks. He is known for his meticulous approach to operations, always seeking marginal gains through data analysis and process optimization. While not always the most charismatic, his dedication and eye for detail are highly valued. His vision for integrating advanced technologies into team operations is what sets him apart, aiming to push the boundaries of performance through cutting-edge solutions.

Zoltán thrives on efficiency and precision. He believes that a well-oiled machine, both literally and figuratively, is the key to success in motorsport. He is constantly looking for ways to streamline workflows and improve communication between departments, ensuring that every member of the team is working in perfect harmony.

physical.hairStyle: Short, neatly combed back with a slight receding hairline
physical.description: Zoltán is of medium height with a slightly stocky build, usually seen in team apparel.

quirks: Always carries a small notebook and pen, jotting down ideas and observations.
Has a habit of tapping his fingers on the table when deep in thought.
Insists on having his desk perfectly organized at all times.
